descriptions.beshbarmak: Classic main dish of Kazakh cuisine: tender boiled meat and thin sheets of dough in a rich sorpa broth
descriptions.kazy: Delicate dry-cured and boiled horse sausage with a noble aroma of garlic and black pepper
descriptions.shuzhyk: Traditional hearty homemade horse meat sausage with a dense texture
descriptions.kuyrdak: Fragrant hot fry of liver, heart, kidneys and meat with golden onion and potatoes
descriptions.zhaya: Dried and smoked horse haunch with a rich meaty flavor
descriptions.shashlyk: Juicy meat marinated with spices and grilled over hot saxaul coals
descriptions.plov: Festive plov with lamb, select lazer rice, sweet yellow carrot, cumin and barberries
descriptions.kurt: Traditional salty-sour dried fermented milk ball, a perfect companion to a cool lager
descriptions.irimshik: Sweet, caramel-like dried curd made from baked milk
descriptions.baursaki: Light golden pillows of yeast dough, fried in hot oil
descriptions.samsa: Crispy flaky tandoor samsa with a juicy meat and onion filling
descriptions.manty: Tender steamed manty with minced meat, onion and pumpkin in very thin dough
descriptions.zheti-as: Rich platter of traditional meat delicacies: kazy, zhaya, karta, zhal
descriptions.pizza-margherita: Classic Neapolitan pizza with San Marzano tomato sauce, creamy mozzarella and fresh basil
descriptions.carbonara: Roman classic with crispy guanciale, egg yolk and tangy Pecorino Romano
descriptions.bruschetta: Crisp toasted ciabatta with juicy tomatoes, garlic, extra virgin olive oil and basil
descriptions.lasagna: Layers of pasta with thick Bolognese meat sauce, silky Bechamel and a parmesan crust
descriptions.risotto: Creamy carnaroli rice risotto cooked in white wine with butter and parmesan
descriptions.tiramisu: Refined dessert of savoiardi biscuits soaked in espresso and the softest mascarpone cream
descriptions.caprese: Fresh slices of ripe tomato and soft fior di latte mozzarella with pesto and olive oil
descriptions.sushi: Classic nigiri with fresh salmon and tuna on rice lightly seasoned with rice vinegar
descriptions.ramen: Rich Japanese soup with springy wheat noodles, tender chashu pork, marinated ajitama egg and nori
descriptions.edamame: Young soybean pods steamed and sprinkled with coarse sea salt
descriptions.tempura: Tiger prawns and seasonal vegetables in a weightless crispy batter with tentsuyu sauce
descriptions.yakitori: Mini chicken skewers on bamboo sticks, glazed with tare sauce
descriptions.mochi: Tender traditional Japanese sweets made of sticky rice dough with a berry filling
descriptions.tonkatsu: Crispy pork cutlet in panko breading, fried until golden
descriptions.burger: Juicy grilled marbled beef patty with melted cheddar, crispy bacon and caramelized onion
descriptions.steak: Grilled beef steak (striploin, tenderloin) with butter and rosemary
descriptions.nachos: Corn chips baked with cheddar, jalapeno, beans and salsa sauce
descriptions.bbq-ribs: Slow-cooked pork ribs from the smoker in a sweet smoky barbecue sauce
descriptions.buffalo-wings: Spicy crispy wings in chili-buffalo sauce with blue cheese dip and celery
descriptions.mac-and-cheese: Baked elbow macaroni in a thick three-cheese sauce with a crispy crust
descriptions.apple-pie: Traditional homemade pie with caramelized apples and cinnamon
descriptions.tacos: Corn tortillas with chopped carnitas pork, cilantro, onion and spicy salsa verde
descriptions.burrito: Hearty tortilla roll with beef, rice, beans, cheese and chipotle sauce
descriptions.guacamole: Smooth dip of ripe avocado with lime juice, tomatoes, cilantro and jalapeno
descriptions.quesadilla: Toasted tortilla with stretchy cheese, chicken and pico de gallo
descriptions.chili-con-carne: Thick spicy stew of beef, black beans, tomatoes and hot chili pepper
descriptions.enchilada: Corn tortilla rolls with chicken under spicy chili sauce and baked cheese
descriptions.churros: Crispy choux dough sticks dusted with cinnamon and sugar, with hot chocolate
descriptions.bratwurst: Traditional German pork sausages with marjoram and caraway, grilled
descriptions.pretzel: Bavarian pretzel with a glossy golden crust and coarse salt crystals
descriptions.schnitzel: Very thin Viennese schnitzel in a crispy golden breading with a lemon wedge
descriptions.sauerkraut: Traditional sauerkraut with a light apple tang and juniper berries
descriptions.currywurst: Fried sausage under a tangy tomato curry sauce
descriptions.kartoffelsalat: German salad of warm boiled potatoes with a mustard-vinegar dressing and bacon
descriptions.strudel: Austrian-Bavarian strudel of stretched dough with apples, raisins and cinnamon
descriptions.lagman-spicy: Uyghur lagman with hand-pulled noodles, lamb, pepper, tomatoes and garlic; the spicy version has chili and ladzhan oil.
descriptions.chak-chak: Fried pieces of dough covered in hot honey; served with tea.
descriptions.okroshka: Cold soup on kvass or kefir with cucumber, radish, herbs, egg and boiled meat.
descriptions.weisswurst: Bavarian white sausages of veal and pork with parsley and lemon zest; warmed in hot water and served with sweet mustard and a pretzel.
descriptions.oysters-raw: Raw oysters on ice with lemon.
descriptions.mussels-steamed: Mussels steamed in white wine with shallots, garlic and parsley.
descriptions.grilled-trout: Whole trout or fillet, grilled, with lemon and herbs.
descriptions.roast-pork: Pork neck or ham roasted to a caramel crust; German-Czech style with braised cabbage.
descriptions.chocolate-fondant: Chocolate cake with a molten center, served warm.
descriptions.chicken-curry: Chicken stewed in a spicy curry sauce with cream or coconut milk; served with rice.
descriptions.cheesecake: Baked creamy cheesecake on a shortbread base (New York style).
descriptions.burrata: Fresh mozzarella cheese with a creamy stracciatella filling; served with tomatoes, olive oil and herbs.
descriptions.beef-tartare: Finely chopped raw beef with capers, shallots, mustard and egg yolk.
descriptions.cheese-aged: Hard aged cheese (parmesan, aged cheddar) or blue cheese (Roquefort, Gorgonzola).
descriptions.sorpa: Strong meat broth left after boiling the meat for beshbarmak; served in a kese bowl, sometimes with kurt.
descriptions.nauryz-kozhe: Festive fermented milk soup with seven ingredients: water, meat, salt, fat, grain, flour and ayran or katyk; served at room temperature.
descriptions.baursaki-kaimak: Hot baursaks with kaymak, thick clotted cream; served with tea, sometimes with honey or jam.
descriptions.lagman: Uyghur lagman: hand-pulled noodles with fried beef, bell pepper, tomatoes, garlic and radish; the mild version.
descriptions.manty-pumpkin: Steamed manty filled with pumpkin, onion and tail fat; served with sour cream.
descriptions.plov-fergana: Uzbek Fergana-style plov: lamb and yellow carrot fried in cottonseed oil, devzira rice, cumin, chickpeas.
descriptions.ganfan: Uyghur dish: rice with fried beef and vegetables in a tomato-garlic sauce.
descriptions.ashlyam-fu: Dungan cold soup: starch jelly and noodles in a sour-spicy dressing with garlic and an egg pancake.
descriptions.kuyrdak-liver: Bauyr kuyrdak: liver, heart and lung fried with onion in tail fat.
descriptions.achichuk: Salad for plov of thinly sliced tomatoes and onion, sometimes with hot pepper and herbs; no oil.
descriptions.shashlyk-chicken: Chicken thigh or breast marinated with spices, cooked over coals.
descriptions.lyulya-kebab: Minced lamb with tail fat and onion on a skewer, cooked over coals; served with onion, sumac and lavash.
descriptions.chebureki: Deep-fried thin half-moon pastries with a juicy meat and onion filling.
descriptions.pelmeni: Boiled pelmeni with minced meat and onion; served with sour cream or butter.
descriptions.khinkali: Georgian boiled dumplings with beef and pork filling, herbs, black pepper and broth inside.
descriptions.khachapuri-adjarian: Yeast dough boat with melted suluguni and imeruli cheese, egg yolk and butter.
descriptions.dolma: Grape leaves stuffed with minced lamb and rice, stewed in broth; served with matsoni and garlic.
descriptions.herring-shuba: Layered salad of salted herring, boiled potato, carrot and beet with onion and mayonnaise.
descriptions.olivier: Salad of boiled potato, carrot and eggs, pickles, peas and chicken (or sausage) with mayonnaise.
descriptions.borsch: Beef broth soup with beet, cabbage, potato and tomato; served with sour cream, garlic and herbs.
descriptions.solyanka: Thick sour-salty soup on meat broth with smoked meats, pickles, olives, capers and lemon.
descriptions.vobla: Dried salted Caspian roach, a classic beer snack.
descriptions.crayfish-boiled: River crayfish boiled in salted water with dill, bay leaf and pepper.
descriptions.garlic-croutons: Sticks of rye bread, deep-fried and rubbed with garlic; often with cheese sauce.
descriptions.napoleon: Flaky layers soaked in custard cream.
descriptions.medovik: Honey cake layers with sour cream frosting.
descriptions.baklava: Thin flaky dough with walnut or pistachio, soaked in honey or sugar syrup.
descriptions.shawarma: Chicken from a vertical grill in lavash with cabbage, cucumbers, tomatoes and garlic sauce.
descriptions.fries: Deep-fried potatoes with salt; usually served with ketchup or cheese sauce.
descriptions.bbq-wings: Fried chicken wings in a sweet smoky barbecue sauce.
descriptions.cheese-plate: Cheese platter: brie or camembert, aged hard cheese, blue cheese; with nuts, honey and grapes.
descriptions.cold-cuts: Salami, dry-cured and smoked sausage, ham and basturma; with mustard and gherkins.
descriptions.garlic-shrimp: Shrimp fried in butter or olive oil with plenty of garlic, parsley and lemon.
descriptions.calamari-rings: Squid rings in batter or breading, deep-fried; with lemon and sauce.
descriptions.mozzarella-sticks: Breaded mozzarella sticks, deep-fried; with tomato or sweet and sour sauce.
descriptions.cheeseburger: Classic cheeseburger: beef patty with processed cheese, pickle, onion, ketchup and mustard.
descriptions.pork-knuckle: Pork knuckle roasted until the skin is crispy; served with braised cabbage, mustard and horseradish.
descriptions.fish-and-chips: Cod fillet in beer batter with fries, lemon and tartar sauce; with malt vinegar.
descriptions.pizza-pepperoni: Pizza with tomato sauce, mozzarella and spicy dry-cured pepperoni sausage.
descriptions.ribeye-steak: Marbled grilled steak from the thick rib end of beef; fattier than striploin and tenderloin.
descriptions.paella: Spanish rice with saffron and seafood (shrimp, mussels, squid), sometimes with chicken; with lemon.
descriptions.caesar-salad: Romaine leaves, grilled chicken, parmesan and croutons with Caesar dressing (yolk, anchovies, garlic, lemon).
descriptions.greek-salad: Tomatoes, cucumbers, sweet pepper, red onion, olives and feta with olive oil, vinegar and oregano.
descriptions.philadelphia-roll: Roll with salmon, cream cheese and cucumber; salmon on the outside.
descriptions.tom-yum: Thai sour-spicy soup with shrimp, lemongrass, galangal, lime leaves, chili and coconut milk.
descriptions.pad-thai: Rice noodles stir-fried with tamarind, fish sauce, egg, chicken or shrimp and peanuts; with lime.
descriptions.pho-bo: Vietnamese beef broth soup with star anise and cinnamon, rice noodles, thinly sliced beef, fresh herbs and lime.
